# Build Workflow Router
**AI-generated by:** Alson (A.I Agent)

Connect available production stages to plain-language requests.

## Interface

```text
Workflow definition + available stage contracts -> route user intents -> workflow router
```

| Input | Scope | Use |
|---|---|---|
| `<destination>/_config/workflow.md` and `setup/initialization-record.md` | Identity, users, products | Supported request intents |
| `<destination>/stages/<stage>/CONTEXT.md` | Triggers, inputs, outputs, handoffs for stages being routed | Reachable paths |
| `../../CONTEXT.md` | Full file | Router shape |
| `../../_config/conventions.md` | Context And Sources; Stage And Routing Contracts | Selective loading |
| `<destination>/_config/stage-registry.md` | Full file | Ordered stages and quality role paths |

**Input gate:** Stop when an intended route has no stage, a stage's job is ambiguous, or its required interface is missing. Confirm the destination before changing existing files.

**One transformation:** Map each supported user intent to its smallest stage; declare sequential dependencies, missing-input stops, and status, pause, and resume routing. Keep workflow-wide behavior in `AGENTS.md`, routing in `CONTEXT.md`, and stage work in stage contracts. Reserve quality and next-action routes using the stage registry.

| Output | Location | Format | Consumer |
|---|---|---|---|
| Intent router | `<destination>/CONTEXT.md` | Markdown | User and execution agent |
| Routing choices or unresolved paths | `<destination>/setup/initialization-record.md` | Markdown | Quality builder and validator |

**Verify:** Every supported request has a reachable stage; no route reads the whole workflow; adjacent stage handoffs agree. A deferred quality path must be resolved before validation passes.
